comment.narrative: At commencement the Ministry mandate and the performance contracts of its management included achieving alignment of its governance and regulatory instruments with the Constitution MEAs and National Development Plans. Efforts to harmonize legislation acts and policies to specifically meet the same target were known to be required but not yet effectively initiated.
TANRM is identified within the MECTHI and at each of its three institutions as the most significant and effective contributor to achieving this result.

National Forest Policy enacted.National Wildlife Policy drafted not yet under consideration by cabinet.CAMPFIRE Policy drafted not yet under consideration by cabinet latest version submitted by the Projects Policy Governance experts attached.Gap analysis and proposals for restructuring Acts covering the three MECTHI parastatals involved in the project have been produced by the Projects Policy Governance experts though none have been yet translated into new Acts.

The indicator references instruments i e. Sector Strategy Acts or Policy not institutions. As of May 2022 all three MECTHI parastals had initiated or planned Sector Strategy Policy or Act updates that TANRM Policy and Governance experts was substantially and comprehensively contributing to
